results.diagnosis: The r10 semantic-repair wording changed the model's coordinate, proving that the repair was no longer a literal repeat. It still allowed either a corrected coordinate or Search/list/detail recovery, so the executor chose another truncated grid tile. Accessibility proved that both proposed coordinates targeted different distractors even though nature_sounds.mp3 was somewhere in the visible candidate set. Both actions were blocked before execution and no file was moved.

guard_assessment.successful_invariant: Both distinct wrong-file long-presses were rejected before actuation.
guard_assessment.r9_repair_regression_status: The repaired response was materially different, so the format-only versus semantic-repair conflict is fixed.
guard_assessment.remaining_failure: A different coordinate is not a safe recovery when several visible grid labels share a truncated prefix.

next_hypothesis.problem: Permitting a corrected long-press coordinate in the single same-screen repair still invites visual guessing because the screenshot cannot distinguish full filenames.
next_hypothesis.generic_fix: After any exact-target mismatch, forbid long_press for that one repair. Require a different action type that changes the information state, such as tapping Search, changing list/grid view, or scrolling. Preserve the one-repair budget and let a later policy step long-press only after a new screen is observed.
next_hypothesis.methodological_boundary: Do not expose an accessibility-derived target coordinate, silently retarget the action, add repair calls, or use evaluator state. The shield may block unsafe actuation and require information-gathering, but the executor must still author every executed action from visible GUI evidence.
next_hypothesis.test_requirement: Assert that EXACT_TARGET_GUARD repair text explicitly forbids action.type=long_press, and integrate an initial mismatch whose only bounded repair is a Search tap.

decision: Preserve r10 and do not launch the formal eight-cell Gate E. A separate r11 may strengthen the exact-target repair from materially-different coordinates to a non-long-press information-gathering action.
